name: Roving Leaders teen program
what_you_do: Build life and leadership skills and talk about hard topics teens face every day. Learn problem solving and how your habits connect to where you live. Join fun, learning and culture activities.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 18 (summer camp listing). The listing does not give other rules.
pay_detail: Free. The summer camp listing shows a cost of $0.
duration: Summer 2026 camp: June 8 to August 7, Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 2 p.m.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 camp ran June 8 to August 7, 2026, and now shows as unavailable. 2027 dates are not posted. The listing says late additions are always welcome.
how_to_apply: Sign up through the city parks registration search for Roving Leaders, or call (512) 974-3927.
notes: Rides are available if you ask. The old city page for Roving Leaders no longer opens after the city site redesign, so this card uses the city sign-up listing. Not a job.
